model_note: The session header reports radient/auto; the harness did not expose the served provider/model id to this session. No translation API, SDK or MT service was used.
scope: Translate every English key added by the agents batch into zh-CN: 11 new namespaces (680 keys) plus 7 keys appended to the existing ui.hub and ui.providers catalogues. Existing zh-CN values are unchanged byte for byte; untouched namespaces and every other locale are out of scope.

validation.generate_check: pass — node scripts/i18n/generate.mjs --check: keys.gen.ts byte-identical to a fresh generation
validation.locale_parity_zh_CN: pass — node --test --test-name-pattern="zh-CN" scripts/i18n/locale-parity.test.mjs: 6/6 tests (key completeness per shipped file, unique keys, placeholder integrity, no English stubs)
validation.icu_parse: 687/687 keys parse under en and zh-CN
validation.placeholder_match: 687/687 keys keep the same argument names, selector arms and number skeletons (::group-off) as English; comparison ran per plural/select arm so a dropped `one` arm is not mistaken for a dropped placeholder
validation.plural_arms: zh-CN uses CLDR `other` only; no `=N` explicit selector exists in this batch's English source, so none was retained
validation.pseudo_marker_render: 687/687 rendered with ⟦arg⟧ string markers and numeric samples at 0/1/2/5/1000000; every marker appeared in the output and no ICU braces remained
validation.markup: onboarding.tour keeps the HTML markup and the ICU apostrophe quoting that carries it; the rendered tag sequence is identical to English in all 84 keys. English prose apostrophes (you'll, agent's) are not reproduced because zh-CN prose does not use them; no ASCII apostrophe was introduced into Chinese text.
validation.english_stubs: 0 — the only English-identical candidates were removed by localizing them: ui.hub.teams.slot_with_count is {role}×{count} (no space) and ui.hub.teams.version is 版本{version}
validation.check_strings: pass — 1343 files scanned, 392 literals at or below baseline
validation.context_parity: pass — every English key covered apart from 131 pre-existing allowed gaps
validation.coverage_gate: node scripts/i18n/check-coverage.mjs exits 1 only for es/fr/hi/ru/ur/vi, which do not carry this batch yet; it reports zero zh-CN gaps. A per-locale branch cannot fill the other six locales and the allowance is shrink-only, so this branch does not touch i18n/coverage-allowance.json.

terminology.Team plan: Team套餐 (product plan name kept in English)

notes: No English catalogue, English context sidecar, ledger row, allowance, shipped marker, code file or other locale was edited.
